title: Tax Form Annotation Document
description: Validates a version 1.0 annotation document that maps values from a structured dataset to printable boxes on an exact U.S. tax-form PDF template.

annotationVersion.description: Version of the annotation specification, independent of the form tax year.

fields.description: Ordered collection of values to render on the PDF template.

formMetadata.title: Form Metadata
formMetadata.description: Identifies the exact PDF template for which the annotation was authored.

formId.description: Stable identifier for the tax-form family, independent of tax year and revision.

title.description: Human-readable title of the tax form.

taxYear.description: Four-digit tax year represented by the form.

revision.description: Identifier for the exact template revision within the tax year.

templateFile.description: Expected filename of the PDF template, without a directory path.

templateSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum of the exact PDF template bytes.

pages.description: Expected pages and their dimensions in PDF points.

pageMetadata.title: Page Metadata
pageMetadata.description: Identifies one PDF page and its expected dimensions.

widthPt.description: Expected visible page width in PDF points.

heightPt.description: Expected visible page height in PDF points.

dataContract.title: Data Contract
dataContract.description: Identifies the structure and version of the dataset referenced by field value sources.

id.description: Stable, provider-independent identifier for the expected dataset structure.

version.description: Major and minor version of the expected dataset structure.

coordinateSystem.title: Coordinate System
coordinateSystem.description: Declares how field positions and page numbers are represented in annotation version 1.0.

unit.description: Coordinates are stored as fractions of the page width and height.

origin.description: The point (0, 0) is located at the top-left of the visible page.

normalizedBox.title: Normalized Box
normalizedBox.description: Defines a printable rectangle using fractions of the visible page width and height with a top-left origin.

x.description: Horizontal position of the rectangle's left edge as a fraction of page width.

y.description: Vertical position of the rectangle's top edge as a fraction of page height.

width.description: Rectangle width as a fraction of page width.

height.description: Rectangle height as a fraction of page height.

valueSource.title: Value Source
valueSource.description: Defines whether a printable value is resolved from the dataset or supplied as a literal constant.

jsonPointerSource.title: JSON Pointer Source
jsonPointerSource.description: References a value in the external dataset using RFC 6901 JSON Pointer syntax.

pointer.description: Absolute JSON Pointer beginning with a slash and using only valid tilde escape sequences.

constantSource.title: Constant Source
constantSource.description: Supplies a literal primitive value that does not depend on the external dataset.

value.description: Literal string, number, boolean, or null value to format and render.

fieldFormat.title: Field Format
fieldFormat.description: Defines the expected source value type and how that value becomes printable text or a mark.

textFormat.title: Text Format
textFormat.description: Formats a JSON string as single-line text.

trim.description: Whether to remove leading and trailing whitespace before rendering.

prefix.description: Optional text added before the formatted value.

suffix.description: Optional text added after the formatted value.

numberFormat.title: Number Format
numberFormat.description: Formats a JSON number without applying currency or percentage scaling.

decimalPlaces.description: Exact number of digits rendered after the decimal separator.

useThousandsSeparator.description: Whether to group thousands in the rendered number.

moneyFormat.title: Money Format
moneyFormat.description: Formats a JSON number as a monetary amount.

decimalPlaces.description: Exact number of digits rendered after the decimal separator.

useThousandsSeparator.description: Whether to group thousands in the rendered amount.

showCurrencySymbol.description: Whether to include currencySymbol in the rendered amount.

currencySymbol.description: Symbol used when showCurrencySymbol is true.

negativeStyle.description: How negative monetary values are displayed.

dateFormat.title: Date Format
dateFormat.description: Formats an ISO calendar-date string without a time or time zone.

inputPattern.description: Required date representation in the source dataset.

outputPattern.description: Supported representation used for the rendered date.

checkboxFormat.title: Checkbox Format
checkboxFormat.description: Formats a JSON boolean as a printable checkbox mark.

trueMark.description: Text rendered when the source value is true.

falseMark.description: Text rendered when the source value is false; an empty string leaves the box blank.

percentageFormat.title: Percentage Format
percentageFormat.description: Formats a JSON number as a percentage with an explicit input scale.

inputScale.description: Whether the source number is a fraction such as 0.125 or an already-scaled percent such as 12.5.

decimalPlaces.description: Exact number of digits rendered after the decimal separator.

showPercentSymbol.description: Whether to append a percent symbol to the rendered value.

maskedIdentifierFormat.title: Masked Identifier Format
maskedIdentifierFormat.description: Inserts characters from a JSON string into a fixed identifier mask.

mask.description: Output mask containing literal separators and placeholder positions.

placeholder.description: Single character in the mask that represents one source character.

multilineTextFormat.title: Multiline Text Format
multilineTextFormat.description: Formats a JSON string for rendering across one or more lines.

preserveNewlines.description: Whether newline characters in the source string force line breaks.

maximumLines.description: Maximum number of lines available for the rendered value.

fieldStyleShape.title: Field Style Shape
fieldStyleShape.description: Defines the supported visual properties for a printable field.

fontFamily.description: Name of a font that the renderer can use or embed.

fontSizePt.description: Preferred font size in PDF points.

minimumFontSizePt.description: Smallest permitted font size when overflow behavior is shrink.

horizontalAlign.description: Horizontal placement of content inside the printable box.

verticalAlign.description: Vertical placement of content inside the printable box.

paddingPt.description: Space in PDF points between content and the printable box edges.

color.description: Text color as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB value.

overflow.description: Action taken when rendered content does not fit inside the printable box.

rotationDegrees.description: Clockwise rotation applied to field content, independent of page rotation.

lineHeight.description: Line-height multiplier applied to the font size for multiline content.

fieldStyle.title: Complete Field Style
fieldStyle.description: Complete visual style required in document-level defaults.

fieldStyleOverride.title: Field Style Override
fieldStyleOverride.description: One or more field-specific visual properties that override document defaults.

fieldBehaviorShape.title: Field Behavior Shape
fieldBehaviorShape.description: Defines how missing, null, and numeric-zero values are handled.

onMissing.description: Action taken when a JSON Pointer path does not exist in the dataset.

onNull.description: Action taken when a source exists but resolves to JSON null.

printZero.description: Whether numeric zero is rendered; this does not affect boolean false.

fieldBehavior.title: Complete Field Behavior
fieldBehavior.description: Complete missing-value behavior required in document-level defaults.

fieldBehaviorOverride.title: Field Behavior Override
fieldBehaviorOverride.description: One or more field-specific behavior properties that override document defaults.

annotationDefaults.title: Annotation Defaults
annotationDefaults.description: Defines the complete style and missing-value behavior inherited by every field.

fieldAnnotation.title: Field Annotation
fieldAnnotation.description: Defines the identity, source, position, formatting, and optional overrides for one printable value.

id.description: Unique, stable semantic identifier for the field within the annotation document.

label.description: Human-readable field name used by authoring tools and diagnostics.

description.description: Optional explanation of the field's tax-form meaning or authoring intent.

page.description: One-based number of the page on which the value is rendered.
